description: This file defines the interface (abstract class) IAuthenticator, which declares methods for authentication-related operations, such as validate, updatePubKey, isStillValid, and resolvePermissions, related to KuksaChannel objects. It serves as a contract for implementing authenticators in the Kuksa vehicle data platform.

classes.name: IAuthenticator
classes.description: An interface for authenticators providing methods for validation, key management, and permission resolution on KuksaChannel objects.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a KuksaChannel using an authentication token.

methods.name: updatePubKey
methods.description: Updates the public key used for authentication.

methods.name: isStillValid
methods.description: Checks if the given KuksaChannel is still valid.

methods.name: resolvePermissions
methods.description: Resolves and sets permissions for the KuksaChannel.
